protocol: validation then frozen held-out final; all three validation seeds completed before final

dataset.split: stratified 60/20/20; split seed and second-stage seed+1

metric: Mean average precision across clean, MCAR 10%, 30%, 50%; equal weight to conditions and seeds
corruptions: Per seed and condition, one fixed MCAR mask reused by every arm; seed+50000+int(rate*1000)
candidate_formula: c=v*(1-m)+alpha*m*mu; alpha in [0,.3,.7,1], training means only; append raw mask
selection: Per-seed alpha maximizes validation mean AP; ties select smaller alpha
control: median imputation fitted on training rows + HistGradientBoostingClassifier, max_iter=120, no mask features
capacity: HistGradientBoostingClassifier max_iter=120, same random_state per seed, clean 3000-row train split for all arms
falsification: Candidate held-out mean paired difference versus median control <=0, or simple mean+mask control matches/exceeds candidate; any selected endpoint alpha is noted as collapse
held_out: No test prediction or score before validation.json is written; each split evaluated once; refuse overwrite unless --allow-rerun
